create or alter procedure [dbo].[FollowObject] @resourceID int, @followTypeID int = 1, @includeChildren bit = 0, @Assetid bigint, @AssetTypeid int AS BEGIN if (@Assetid !=0 or @AssetTypeid !=0) begin insert into Follow (ResourceID, DateCreated, FollowTypeID, AssetId, AssetTypeId) values ( @resourceID, getutcdate(), @followTypeID, case when @Assetid !=0 then @Assetid else null end, case when @Assetid =0 then @AssetTypeid else null end)
IF (@followTypeID = 3) AND (@AssetTypeid IS NOT NULL) BEGIN delete F from Follow F inner join FollowDetail FD on FD.Assetid = F.AssetID and FD.HardFollow = 0 and F.ResourceID = FD.ResourceID and F.ResourceID = @resourceID and FD.AssetTypeid = @AssetTypeid ; END END END
